bio: Welcome, Class of 2029! I grew up in Methuen, MA, and I graduated from Harvard in 2014 with a concentration in Government and a citation in Spanish. As a student, I played for Harvard's varsity basketball team, and I also spent three months completing an internship in Lima, Peru. Currently, I work in Harvard's Office of Undergraduate Research and Fellowships, and I live in Grays Hall with my wife Kasey, our daughters Ellie and Avery, and our cat Piper. We're thrilled to meet you all! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
